title: ECP Case (public representation)
description: Versioned public case contract. The public representation is strictly separable from protected ground truth: a case carries ONLY a cryptographic commitment to the sealed ground-truth document (expected answer, derivation, verification rule live in the protected store, outside the public repository). Inline ground-truth content is structurally impossible here - the schema admits no expected-answer or derivation fields, and unknown keys are rejected.

case_status.description: Lifecycle: authored candidates become 'registered' only through the registration contract; 'quarantined' removes a case from use without deleting history.

case_family.description: Free-form family label (no predefined taxonomy is imposed at the contract level; authors self-report families).

prompt.description: The exact self-contained prompt submitted to the evaluated system.

constraints.description: Conditions under which the system must operate (e.g. premises-only reasoning, no external lookup).

success_criterion.description: Human-verifiable statement of what counts as success, frozen at registration time.

binding.description: Where the full rule implementation lives. The rule semantics detail belongs to the protected ground truth; the public rule is an identifier and type.

commitment.description: SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of the protected ground-truth document.

sealing_status.description: A case MUST be 'sealed' before registration; 'pending' marks commitment not yet published.

seal_holder.description: Who holds the protected ground-truth document (outside the public repository).

information_boundary.description: Declared information boundary of the authoring environment ('isolated': author had no access to project knowledge; see the authoring order of the relevant phase).

authoring_environment.description: Provenance of the authoring environment (tools, access, isolation).

authoring_reference.description: Reference to the authoring order/protocol under which the case was produced.

difficulty.description: Optional authored difficulty annotation (authoring-phase semantics; not adjudicated here).

structural_signature.description: Optional authoring-phase annotation describing what structurally distinguishes this case (entity/number/wording swaps do not count as structural difference).

proposed_reasoning_family.description: Optional author-self-reported reasoning family (no predefined taxonomy is imposed).
